procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the operator's MEL

inform.para: A procedure must be established and used to ensure that all crewmembers are briefed about the missing or inoperative supplementary life raft, passenger distribution and modified cabin safety procedures.

procitem.title: Calculation of maximum passenger capacity (MPC) tables

inform.para: A procedure must be established and used to compute the reduced number of passengers in the cabin.
